CustomField.description: Controls how strictly the AI prompt safety guard evaluates user questions and AI responses. Applies to both Gemini Developer API and Agent Platform. Allowed values: Strict, Standard, Relaxed, Off. When blank or unrecognized, the safety guard runs in Standard mode.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Allowed values: Strict, Standard, Relaxed, Off. When blank, the guard runs in Standard mode.
CustomField.label: AI Safety Mode
